dynamic.title: QR with expiry and revocation
dynamic.noExpiryHint: Leave empty for no expiry. The time is converted to UTC before sending.
dynamic.notice: Dynamic QR needs a server for redirects and expiry. The server stores the destination, creation/expiry/revocation times and a management-key hash; no photos or documents. Records remain until an operator removes them. Revocation stops redirects without deleting the record.
dynamic.consent: I agree to store the destination and information above to create a dynamic QR.
dynamic.empty: Enter a destination and create a code to preview it.
dynamic.needsNetwork: Scanning requires a network connection. Share this code only with intended recipients.
dynamic.keyNotice: The revocation key is returned only once and stays in this session by default. Download a receipt or explicitly save on this device. This tool cannot revoke a code without its key.
dynamic.active: Receipt: not revoked from this session
dynamic.loadSaved: Open codes saved on this device
dynamic.noSaved: No codes saved on this device.
dynamic.saveDevice: Save codes and management keys on this device
dynamic.revokeConfirm: Revoke this code? Revoked codes cannot be reactivated.
dynamic.forgetHint: Forgetting removes the device copy; it does not revoke the server code.
dynamic.failed: Creation failed. Your input is retained; check the network before retrying.
dynamic.invalid: Use a public HTTPS URL without credentials and a future expiry.
dynamic.rateLimit: Hourly QR creation limit reached. Try again later.
dynamic.revokeFailed: Revocation failed. Check the network and receipt before retrying.
dynamic.storageFailed: Could not save on this device. Download a receipt to retain the key.
dynamic.receiptInvalid: Invalid receipt or larger than 16 KB.

labels.invalid: Labels must fit A4; margins 5–20 mm, gaps 0–10 mm and no more than 500 total labels.
labels.codeInvalid: Invalid code, dense QR or barcode does not fit. Check each value or increase label dimensions.
labels.fileInvalid: Could not read file or larger than 1 MB.
labels.changed: {{total}} values normalized (uppercase / check digit). Review before printing.

steps.1: Choose an image or open the camera
steps.2: Keep the entire code clear and visible
steps.5: Copy the content or scan another code

tips.1: Use a straight, well-lit photo without glare
tips.2: Keep the blank border around QR codes

1.a: Yes. It detects QR codes and common barcodes including EAN, UPC and Code 128. One code is read per image.

2.q: Are images sent to a server?
2.a: Images are decoded in your browser. Images and code content are not uploaded to a server for decoding.

3.q: Why is my code not detected?
3.a: The code may be blurry, cropped, too small or affected by glare. Try a clearer photo with the whole border visible.

4.q: Can I use a phone camera?
4.a: Yes. Allow camera access when prompted. If the camera cannot open, take a photo and upload it instead.

create.title: Create QR codes
create.subtitle: Create QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts and more

tips.1: Use dark codes on light backgrounds
tips.2: Keep a clear border around the code
tips.3: Use SVG or PDF for printing

1.a: Static codes directly contain your content and have no expiry set by this tool. Links or information within them may still become invalid.

2.q: Can I change colors and backgrounds?
2.a: Yes. Open customization to choose code colors and a white, transparent or custom background. Keep sufficient contrast.

3.a: Dynamic codes redirect through a server and can expire or be revoked using a management key. Select Dynamic QR to review storage information before creating one.

steps.3: Enter content or upload CSV / Excel
steps.4: Choose print size and bar height

tips.2: EAN / ITF-14 numbers must be legitimately assigned
tips.3: Keep clear space at both ends
tips.4: Print and scan a sample before a full batch

1.a: Code 128 suits internal letter and number identifiers. Code 39 suits compatible systems. EAN and ITF-14 require legitimately assigned numbers.

2.a: Yes. Choose Batch and upload CSV or Excel. The first column is validated and exported as PDF or PNG / SVG archives.

3.a: PDF uses the chosen dimensions. The on-screen preview may be scaled to fit. Print at actual size and test scanning.

steps.1: Enter an HTTPS link and optional expiry
steps.2: Read the storage notice and consent
steps.3: Create a code or import a receipt
steps.4: Download the code and keep its receipt

tips.1: The management key is returned only once
tips.3: Save on a private device when needed

1.a: It contains the code and key required to revoke it. Lost keys cannot be recovered by this tool; keep receipts private.

2.a: No. Forgetting only removes the copy from this device or session. Use Revoke QR to stop redirection on the server.

3.a: Yes. Creation, revocation and opening dynamic codes require the server. Storage details are explained before you consent.
